'''Units''' ---- Some towers can spawn '''Units''' which are essentially mobile vehicles or people that move along the path from the exit to the entrance. Some of the units are stationary and do not move at all. They generally spawn at a set rate, but can also spawn with player input or by meeting a specific requirement, such as amount of Scrap. In two-pathed maps, the number of units spawned per trigger is not duplicated. Units will go down a random path.
